data.summary: Shipped in three commits on main. affb078 (design, landed first per convention): T5 revised to eleven verbs — relay_answer records an out-of-band escalation answer; attribution semantics and guard rails documented in 002-technology.md, T7 notes the "Needs Input" inbox header, CLAUDE.md law updated. 5fff97b (implementation): additive answered_by field on escalation.answered (stored bytes untouched; golden regenerated); replay attributes to answered_by with envelope-actor fallback for pre-field events and sets RelayedBy when they differ; opRelayAnswer derives the root principal server-side (never agent-supplied), rejects already-answered escalations with a 409-shaped tool error; HTTP steering path unchanged in behavior (still last-answer-wins) but now stamps answered_by; eleventh MCP tool registered; relayed_by exposed on escalationJSON both sides; views/CLI/TUI detail render "(relayed by ...)" and view format bumped 1→2; agent-protocol.md gains the answered-out-of-band flow. Tests: TestMCPRelayAnswer (real SDK client: blocking flow, attribution on the event bytes, readiness unblock via claim_next, re-relay + unknown-escalation rejections, root-session self-relay with no marker), TestAnswerAttribution replay table, views golden with a relayed answer, TUI detail assertion. 4d37d1f: inbox header "Open escalations" → "Needs Input" in TUI and escalations command; entity name kept everywhere per the steering decision. make test lint green at each commit. Two readings to be aware of: (1) "TUI inbox shows out-of-band-answered escalations as answered" — implemented as: answered escalations leave the Needs Input section (settled questions stop polluting the signal, per this task's own rationale) and render as answered with the relayed text in the task detail screen and the escalations command's Answered section; if the inbox itself should list recently-answered entries, that's a small follow-up. (2) The MCP behavior tests live at the daemon layer (internal/daemon/mcp_test.go, real SDK client over the real socket); the shim-level mcp_cli_test asserts relay_answer is in the mirrored surface but has no shim round-trip of the verb — the shim is a transparent proxy already round-tripped by other verbs. Deferred deliberately: the daemon running on any given machine needs a rebuild+restart (make build) before relay_answer is live there; no restart was performed.
